nodes.name: Manual run (backfill)
nodes.notes: Manual/on-demand trigger for the full sync (used by the dashboard's Actualizar button). Responds immediately on receipt so the caller isn't left holding an HTTP connection open for the whole sync (~15-25s) — the sync keeps running in the background regardless of whether anything is still listening for the response.

nodes.name: Fetch Leads Page
nodes.notes: Attach the Kommo Header Auth credential after import. Uses n8n's built-in HTTP Request pagination (page = $pageCount + 1, one request every 350ms) instead of a manual Code-node loop. The manual loop parsed Kommo's _links.next.href to decide whether to keep going, but that stayed stuck after page 1 in production — the sync never got past the first 250 leads. Built-in pagination stops on 'response is empty', matching Kommo's documented behavior of returning nothing once you page past the last lead, so it doesn't depend on _links being well-formed.

nodes.name: Split leads
nodes.notes: Built-in pagination emits one item per page fetched (each with its own _embedded.leads array). This flattens every page's leads into one item per lead before transforming.

nodes.name: Transform page
nodes.notes: Field IDs below are specific to this Kommo account. agenda/cita_asistida/cotizacion/cierre are date_time custom fields; campaign/adset/ad reused from existing fields. Runs once per lead.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO kommo_statuses (pipeline_id, status_id, pipeline_name, status_name, sort, status_type) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) ON CONFLICT (pipeline_id, status_id) DO UPDATE SET pipeline_name=excluded.pipeline_name, status_name=excluded.status_name, sort=excluded.sort, status_type=excluded.status_type;
INSERT INTO kommo_loss_reasons (loss_reason_id, name) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (loss_reason_id) DO UPDATE SET name=excluded.name;
